payload.title: Spikes before freezing the multilingual design
payload.description:
As the planner of multilingual publishing, I want cheap experiments to answer the questions that decide the design, so we freeze the version model, alignment, edge redirect and budget on evidence rather than guesses.

Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450), section 'Spikes before the design is frozen'. No live publishing, nothing made by hand in the cloud; any deployed experiment goes through the pipeline to a sandbox or preview stack.

Acceptance: each child task records its measurements and a recommendation as a comment on this epic, and the plan document is updated where the evidence changes it.
